songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The first cold air met me outside
And turned my collar toward my chin
Across the street the maple burned
Like copper coins laid thin
I had stepped out for ordinary bread
And found the whole block new
One copper leaf turned in my palm

[Chorus]
The colored street takes one long breath
Breathe With Me
My grateful hands go soft and open
As leaves move down the lane
A copper leaf turns in my palm

[Verse 2]
Back by the window, cup in hand
I watched the steam climb clear
The kettle clicked, the room stayed kind
And autumn settled here
The cup warmed both my careful hands

[Chorus]
The colored street takes one long breath
Breathe With Me
My grateful hands go soft and open
As leaves move down the lane
A copper leaf turns in my palm

I Know You're Near

[Verse 1: Male Vocal]
